scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.config.ts && npm run build:connectors
scripts.build:connectors: vite build --config integrations/openclaw/quick-connect.vite.config.ts && vite build --config integrations/connector/vite.config.ts && node scripts/package-openclaw.mjs
scripts.test:sdk:python: cd sdk/python && python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py
scripts.cf:check: npm run cf:config-check && npm run test:cloudflare && wrangler deploy --dry-run --containers-rollout=none --env staging && wrangler deploy --dry-run --containers-rollout=none --env beta && wrangler deploy --dry-run --containers-rollout=none --config scanner/wrangler.beta.jsonc
scripts.cf:deploy: node -e "throw new Error('Choose cf:deploy:staging or cf:deploy:beta; an unqualified deploy targets the old production Worker')"
scripts.cf:deploy:staging: npm run cf:config-check && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.cf:deploy:beta: npm run cf:config-check && wrangler deploy --env beta
scripts.cf:deploy:scanner:beta: npm run cf:config-check && wrangler deploy --config scanner/wrangler.beta.jsonc
